title: Marine Structural Integrity and Safety
summary: The core of the SMI Lab: mechanics-based assessment of safety, damage tolerance, and life-cycle performance of marine and offshore structures.
topics: Fatigue and fracture mechanics of welded marine structures
Ultimate strength and collapse under extreme loading
Damage tolerance and residual strength assessment
Corrosion and ageing effects on life-cycle performance

title: Offshore Infrastructure Design and Analysis
summary: Design, reliability, and monitoring of next-generation offshore renewable energy platforms, including floating offshore wind turbines (FOWTs).
topics: Structural design of floating offshore wind turbine (FOWT) platforms
Coupled environmental loading and long-term response

title: Advanced Marine Engineering Solutions
summary: Safe and efficient fuel containment systems analysis, supporting maritime decarbonisation and the green shipping transition.
topics: Containment systems for alternative marine fuels
Risk and safety assessment for novel fuel systems

title: Intelligent and Digital Marine Structures
summary: Digital methods grounded in physics-based structural mechanics, so that data-driven models remain interpretable, reliable, and suitable for safety-critical marine applications.
topics: Structural health monitoring (SHM) and sensor-informed assessment
Digital twins for in-service structural condition
